Description.Name: Visor Strike Vehicle
Description.Details: The C configuration of the Visor Strike Vehicle transports battle armor on long missions. It mounts two Clan Medium Pulse Lasers and a TAG in the turret, so it does not rely on ammunition, and its cargo container stores supplies and mission equipment next to the Battle Armor Compartment. It is one of the few configurations that Society logistics personnel are allowed to use. Biome Restrictions: None. Movement: 8/12 hexes / 240/360 meters. Armor: Ferro-Fibrous (C) Structure: Structure Values A S Front 155 20 Left 110 20 Right 110 20 Rear 110 20 Turret 110 20 Total 595 100 Quirk: Easy to Maintain Can Resupply/Repair Can carry 4 Battle Armor Squads.

YangsThoughts: You'd never pick it out of traffic, Boss, because it looks just like a Puller, the civilian trailer truck nearly every industrial world builds. The Society wanted its undercover intervention teams to have heavy weapons close at hand, so the turret's tucked into the worker compartment behind the cab and the rest of the guns stay covered until the crew needs them. But in reality it is not simple truck. They gave it a bigger XL fusion engine and thicker Clan-grade ferro-fibrous armor, so small arms won't bother it much, and with thirteen tons of pod space it can handle most support jobs.
